title: The Radar Saw Them
sentences: Nearly an hour before the bombs fell on Pearl Harbor, radar saw the attackers coming.
At 7:02 that morning, two Army privates at Opana Point on Oahu spotted a huge blip.
It was about 132 miles north, the largest they had ever seen.
They phoned the information center at Fort Shafter.
The officer there, Lieutenant Kermit Tyler, told them not to worry about it.
B-17 bombers were due from California, and he assumed that was it.
